## About

Satria Nugraha is a software developer and IT infrastructure professional with hands-on experience across backend development, system administration, and technical consulting. His work centres on building dependable systems, diagnosing complex issues, and improving operational reliability.

He has supported healthcare IT environments, delivered technical solutions for enterprise clients, and developed backend services in project-based settings. His approach is methodical: understand the root cause, fix it properly, and document the outcome.

Currently based in Lamongan, East Java, Indonesia. Open to international opportunities — both remote and relocation.
